summary: Home hero reserved for video: no photo recommendation or replacement there. Reviewed 4,176 Drive preview entries, 2,181 readable unique disk JPEG/PNG copies, 243 existing credited album derivatives, and 11 embedded RAW previews. Sources overlap; these counts are not unique moments. 76 disk JPEG/PNG copies failed decoding; 135 exact duplicates excluded. 13 RAW files found: two yielded no preview and one preview is visibly damaged. RAWs are organizer portraits, not better match winners. Downloaded 47 Drive originals and verified checksums; inspected 27 disk originals at full detail (74 shortlisted original checks). All 108 current image export entries were skimmed. Not every archive image was inspected at original size.
gaps: No watch-party source inspected meets a literal grain-free, close-up full-screen bar. Use restrained cards, obtain better originals, or replace large placements with the strongest clean football photos where the story permits.
SZN6 originals are mostly 2–3k pixels with softened detail; no larger version found in its Picks folder. Keep event-specific photos at medium size.
Turf has unreadable and partly corrupted files. The two intact group frames are contextual picks, not pristine close-up hero images.

SZN5 and Ground Zero have credited ThePapare derivatives on disk/site; source camera originals were not found. Preserve watermarks and credits. SZN5 video still is excluded from the photos-only shortlist.
Team portraits cannot be forced into narrow portrait crops without removing people. Change the frame ratio or compose a separate phone layout.
Formal Drive headshots have no verified person-to-role mapping. Team section currently has no live portrait slots; do not assign identities.

Archive browsing can retain event coverage separately; feature only the curated highlights. This report does not certify every archive photo as pristine. Unused legacy gallery p01–p19/v01–v04 data is not a live placement in the current gallery route.
Actual website replacement/export/animation checks remain a separate implementation step. This report includes crop guidance and simulations, not final retouched assets or a deployed site.
